purpose: Compare the current Browser semantic mutation surface with a smaller typed semantic surface plus a purely mechanical compiler, without granting Semantic Logic or the compiler any production authority.

historical_findings: semantic_execute_v0.4 treatment completed 3/3 real tasks but all three rows still first-called navigate with a non-resource/non-GroundingRef target_ref before recovering
typed waits reduced wait-contract failures to zero in A2 while task instability remained in navigation/action organization
FC2-B bounded clause DSL first call failed 6/6 and exposed a canonical identity vocabulary mismatch; this is evidence against a larger high-level DSL for P4
FC2-C v0.2 proved that narrow mechanically-derived provider-visible required-field facts can restore declaration FCR without widening runtime semantics

llm_owns: semantic argument values such as text/value/url/delta_pages
whether an ActionReceipt satisfies the user task
compiler_may_derive: verb from the selected typed tool identity
canonical args container from typed tool fields
scope_ref from exact hydrated object/resource ref
target_id from exact hydrated object/resource ref
expected_version from exact hydrated object/resource ref
deterministic action_id from the exact declared semantic request
forbidden_compiler_behavior: name/role fuzzy matching or best-match substitution
tool routing based on inferred user intent

shared_surface.rule: The shared surface, descriptions, schemas, execution semantics, and underlying Browser adapters must be byte-identical across A and B during a formal run.

browser_semantic_execute.target_ref_contract: object verbs use exact SemanticObject.grounding_ref; navigate uses exact snapshot resource_ref

compiler_contract.execution_location: P4 isolated harness only; no Factory or production registry consumer in P4
compiler_contract.object_ref: exact hydrate only; unavailable/expired/unauthorized/wrong projection rejects before dispatch
compiler_contract.resource_ref: exact resource grounding only; object GroundingRef or URL-as-ref rejects before dispatch
compiler_contract.required_equivalence: For the same exact observed ref and semantic values, the canonical SemanticAction passed to BrowserActionAdapter must be identical to Arm A BrowserSemanticExecuteTool.compile_request on every authority-bearing field.
compiler_contract.no_new_execution_path: Formal P4 A/B must delegate B to the same existing BrowserActionAdapter path as A; only the model-facing declaration surface and mechanical compile step differ.

error_taxonomy.P4-X01: non-resource value or URL placed in Arm A target_ref for navigate
error_taxonomy.P4-X03: grounding_ref supplied to browser_perceive(action=snapshot); shared negative-control error
error_taxonomy.P4-X04: scope predicate target/scope mismatch; must remain zero in both arms because typed waits are shared
error_taxonomy.P4-X05: version_scope guessed or model-supplied; must remain impossible in both arms
error_taxonomy.P4-X06: verb/args cross-binding or args wrapper mismatch
error_taxonomy.P4-X07: identity vocabulary cannot represent canonical object kind; Arm B must avoid identity re-description by consuming exact object_ref
error_taxonomy.P4-X08: schema reread/progressive-disclosure detour before first mechanically valid semantic call

qualification_stages.name: deterministic compiler equivalence
requirements: exact equality of authority-bearing SemanticAction fields against Arm A compile_request
no dispatch occurs for any compile rejection
same declared request produces deterministic action_id
qualification_stages.gate: 100% deterministic PASS before any model FCR run

qualification_stages.name: first-call declaration A/B
qualification_stages.purpose: Isolate provider-visible structural usability before Browser side effects or recovery loops can confound the result.
qualification_stages.pairing: same task and repeat, A/B paired
qualification_stages.arm_order: repeat 1/3 A->B; repeat 2/4 B->A; tasks rotate in a fixed pre-run order
b_hard_gate: 20/20 first semantic calls mechanically valid under the frozen B logical schema
no normalization, retry, Browser runtime, fallback, or task-completion judgment
comparative_metrics: schema_reread_intent_or_request if observable without executing tools

qualification_stages.name: full-task paired A/B

held_out_from_prior_design_tasks.external_oracle: selected value equals fixture target and confirmation side effect count is exactly one
reveal condition is observed and activation side effect count is exactly one
stale ref dispatch count is zero; a later explicitly model-selected fresh ref may dispatch exactly once

qualification_stages.pairing: same task and repeat, A/B paired; repeat1 A->B, repeat2 B->A

shared_runtime_contract.row_isolation: fresh session/data/Browser profile per row; strictly serial

hard_safety_gates: all 24 rows executed; no post-hoc replay of failed rows
exact frozen arm surface on every provider request
wrong/stale ref never causes physical dispatch
receipt ok is never used as the external task oracle
P4-X04 scope mismatch=0 and P4-X05 model version_scope supply=0 in both arms

promotion_gate.strict_improvement_required: At least one of targeted mechanical error count or schema reread count must be strictly lower in B; if A is already zero on both, B instead needs task parity plus at least 10% lower provider-surface schema chars without increasing tool failures.
promotion_gate.timeouts: worker timeout counts as task failure/right-censoring and is not silently reclassified as infra-invalid
promotion_gate.infra_invalid: Only pre-task environment failure with no model/task opportunity may invalidate a row; invalidation reason must be mechanical and frozen before inspecting task outcome.

evidence_rules: Freeze task/fixture/provider-surface/runner/scorer hashes before the first formal model row.
External page-state oracle, not model text or ActionReceipt ok, determines task result.
Raw call/receipt facts are persisted separately from offline scorer judgments.
Do not normalize away wrong refs, wrong tool selection, wrong args, rejected receipts, timeouts, or schema rereads.
Do not change prompts, schemas, budgets, row order, scorer, or gate after seeing formal results.
Known historical tasks are continuity evidence; the three new held-out-from-prior-design tasks are frozen before P4 implementation and must not be removed if they are inconvenient.
